systems.system: connection of the police referral app and unmanned police service centers to the Fayda national digital ID system
systems.owner: Ethiopian Federal Police; National ID Program
systems.tiers: stated by the Federal Police Chief Commissioner on 12 March 2026 at a meeting with deputy commissioners of all regional states; no count of sites given

note: No fact: the Chief Commissioner names a police referral app and unmanned police service centers without saying what either does, and says both are connected to the national digital ID; nothing is stated about how stations record reports or cases.
